case.ceiling: margin 0: film + nodes(s) + systems + tube = L

model.node_count: V(s) = 8*pi*R^2/(sqrt(3)*s^2) + 2 (equilateral continuum; pinned by 29.061 kg at s=1)
model.mass: m_tube(s) = L - 97.515 - 0.02*V(s) - 50; A = m_tube/(M*s*rho); film mass fixed by area at any s
model.section: exact annulus: t_w = r_o - sqrt(r_o^2 - A/pi), I = pi/4*(r_o^4 - r_i^4)
model.p_local: 2*sigma_local*A/(R*s) with sigma_local = 0.6*E*t_w/r_o (SP-8007 classical E*t/(r*sqrt(3(1-nu^2))), gamma=1 assumed, QUESTIONABLE)
model.SF: p_limit / p_ext; maximise the least of the four
model.slender_rule: r_o <= s/3 (stated design rule so members remain slender columns)

scan.r_o_range: from sqrt(A/pi) (solid tube) to min(0.25 m, s/3)

cross_checks.name: node mass at s=1 (0.02*V) vs pin 29.061 kg
film required sigma at s=1 vs 005 5.966e8 Pa
008 scaling: M55J SF_yield at fixed r_o = Al SF_yield * (sig/rho) ratio

kd_comparison.scaling: SF_buckling proportional to kd (required E as 1/kd); numbers are MAINLINE-004's own
kd_comparison.P3_note: the P3 limits are member formulas with no spherical knockdown in this model; P3's least SF does not rescale with 004's kd. Global frame buckling is unmodelled (NFI-011-GLOBAL).
